request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

A key ON THE TABLE. One ordinary silver metal house key on a plain metal ring lies in the middle of the top of a small plain wooden table that stands on a light wooden floor in front of a plain white wall. The camera is a little above table height, so the whole table top, the four legs and the floor under the table are all visible: the key is clearly on the table and the floor under the table is empty. The key is close enough to be clearly a key. Nothing else is on the table; no chairs, no other objects, no people. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.
